task.title: Add a request link to the no-benchmark notice
task.description:
## Why
PR #5 built most of this story: the shipped benchmarks travel inside the engine bundle, Python picks the one that matches the league's format, and a league in another format still gets a report, with a notice on the board that depth was graded as average.

What is left: the notice gives the visitor no way to ask for their format.

## Steps
1. Add a link to the no-benchmark notice that opens a pre-filled GitHub issue requesting that format (team count, Superflex or 1QB, PPR setting, TE premium).
2. Take the format values from the report, not from user-typed text.

## Done when
- A league in a format with no benchmark shows the notice with a working request link.

comments.author: dylan@dgoings.com
comments.body: Trimmed to what is left after PR #5 (benchmarks ship with the engine, the report builds without one, and the board shows a notice). Lowered to low: the remaining piece is one link.
